definitions.gloss: to report; to notify; to file
definitions.explanation: To formally report or notify authorities or an organization about something, such as filing official documents or reporting incidents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}た。
examples.english: I filed a change of address notice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紛失|ふんしつ}→紛失：14894_funshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}た。
examples.english: I reported the loss to the police.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出生|しゅっせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}る。
examples.english: To register a child's birth at the city office.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}る: to report ~ to the police
- ⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}る: to give notice of a change of address
- {出生|しゅっせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}る: to register a birth
- {届|とど}け{出|で}: the noun, a notification or report filed ({届|とど}け{出|で}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧, notification required)

WATCH OUT:
- With the name of a form (⟦{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}→婚姻届：22413_konintodoke⟧, ⟦{退職届|たいしょくとどけ}→退職届：15695_taishokutodoke⟧), say ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ or ⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: ⟦{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}→婚姻届：22413_konintodoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧. ⟦{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}→婚姻届：22413_konintodoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}る repeats ⟦{届|とど}け→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧ (to deliver, to report) + ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to come forward).
